checks: program byte hash, canonical hash, raw score hash and run metadata binding
exact shared scorer source set and all source hashes
all logical and executed instruction counts from independent AST walk
all component access totals and unique cached operand keys from independent AST walk
energy and cycle component sums and display conversions
independent per-port tape-stage energy and blocking cycles
complete tape input/output counts and round-robin port layout
allocated scratch totals, final written-address coverage and capacity
independent tile occupancy counts and per-tile capacity
frozen full-size program metadata, declared serialization and processor counts
limitations: This lightweight audit does not recompute full per-address scratch energy or the placement hash. Those computations come from the completed unmodified repository scorer.
Final write coverage does not independently prove that every read follows initialization; the unmodified scorer validates instruction legality and initialization order.
This audit does not establish numerical accuracy.
